content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending the agreement. I have a brief suggestion for your review. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms transfer intellectual property ownership immediately upon creation before full payment is guaranteed. I propose modifying this so that ownership of the deliverables transfers upon full payment of all fees due under the agreement. Thank you, and best regards,
